parity_precheck.within_variant_rule: Every repeated response for a case must have one exact body hash, status, result order, and SVG availability.
parity_precheck.cross_variant_rule: Control and treatment must have equal status, exact body hash, result order, and SVG availability for every case.
parity_precheck.failure_action: Delete the isolated endpoint immediately. Do not start latency sampling.

recommendation_measurement.task: Choose an icon for application settings.

required_stage_evidence: search_stage_timing logs exported from the isolated function
required_closeout_evidence: production search-icons and mcp-search versions before and after
npm latest and beta tags before and after
direct hosted search first and warm results
localized MCP first and warm results
safe stage-log export or an explicit incomplete-measurement verdict
allowed_external_mutations: deploy control commit 53191e366 to mcp-search-v2-beta for parity
deploy treatment commit 87c445b7c to mcp-search-v2-beta for parity
deploy control commit 53191e366 to mcp-search-v2-beta for search measurement
deploy treatment commit 87c445b7c to mcp-search-v2-beta for search measurement
deploy control commit 53191e366 to mcp-search-v2-beta for recommendation measurement
deploy treatment commit 87c445b7c to mcp-search-v2-beta for recommendation measurement
delete mcp-search-v2-beta after measurement or immediately after a stop trigger
allowed_read_only_actions: list hosted functions and npm tags before and after
send the fixed internal measurement requests
export only search_stage_timing function logs for the measurement window
prohibited_actions: user invitation or public beta message

rollback.parity_failure: Delete the isolated endpoint and do not begin latency sampling.
rollback.latency_or_error_failure: Delete the isolated endpoint, leave stable production functions unchanged, and record the failed gate.
rollback.security_or_private_data_failure: Stop immediately, delete the isolated endpoint, and do not export or commit unsafe log content.
rollback.log_export_failure: Delete the isolated endpoint and mark the measurement incomplete. Do not publish.
